decision_conditions: The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:1742AT_HH1 SH11742AT_HH1 SH2Design and Access StatementSuDs Proforma Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority,  cycle parking must be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of TWO long stay cycle parking spaceso	in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofReason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved,  the existing wall along the front boundary of the site shall be retained in order to prevent illegal and unsafe vehicle movements. Reason: In the interests of highway safety
description: Single storey side extension with roof lights, new door and window at side elevation and front porch infill.
